MOD = 998244353
N = int(input())
P = list(map(lambda x: int(x)-1, input().split()))
S = input()

def pow(a, b):
    if b == 0:
        return 1
    ret = pow((a**2) % MOD, b // 2)
    if b % 2:
        ret = ret * a % MOD
    return ret

def countL():
    cnt = 0
    spoon = [False] * N
    for p in P:
        match S[p]:
            case "L":
                spoon[p] = True
            case "R":
                if not spoon[(p+1) % N]:
                    return 0
                spoon[p] = True
            case "?":
                if spoon[(p+1) % N]:
                    cnt += 1
                spoon[p] = True
    return pow(2, cnt)

def countR():
    cnt = 0
    spoon = [False] * N
    for p in P:
        match S[p]:
            case "R":
                spoon[(p+1) % N] = True
            case "L":
                if not spoon[p]:
                    return 0
                spoon[(p+1) % N] = True
            case "?":
                if spoon[p]:
                    cnt += 1
                spoon[(p+1) % N] = True
    return pow(2, cnt)

ans = 0
match S[P[0]]:
    case "L":
        ans = countL()
    case "R":
        ans = countR()
    case "?":
        ans = (countL() + countR()) % MOD
